name: Descent
description: A staircase whose treads shorten as it goes down, so the flight steepens.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 100%, 0 @calc(70 - 60 * @y / @Y)%, 50% @calc(70 - 60 * @y / @Y)%, 50% @calc(85 - 30 * @y / @Y)%, 100% @calc(85 - 30 * @y / @Y)%, 100% 100%); clip-path: polygon(0 100%, 0 @calc(70 - 60 * @y / @Y)%, 50% @calc(70 - 60 * @y / @Y)%, 50% @calc(85 - 30 * @y / @Y)%, 100% @calc(85 - 30 * @y / @Y)%, 100% 100%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
